Rashi on Eruvin 16b:10:1.hebrew: ומקיפין בקנים - נעוצים ועומדים. זו היא מחיצה של שתי, אבל של חבלים הויא מחיצה של ערב:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:10:1.english: And one may surround with reeds - [They are] stuck [in the ground] and standing [upright]. This is a partition of warp [i.e., vertical elements], but [that] of ropes is a partition of woof [i.e., horizontal elements].

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:11:1.hebrew: בשיירא דברו - הקילו אצלו, שאינן צריכים אלא או שתי או ערב — שתי כגון קנים, ערב כגון חבלים. אבל ליחיד לא הקילו, עד שיהא בה שתי וערב:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:11:1.english: They spoke of a caravan - They were lenient in its case, in that they need only either warp or woof — warp, such as reeds; woof, such as ropes. But for an individual they were not lenient, unless it has [both] warp and woof.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:12:1.hebrew: כל מחיצה שאינה כו' - רבי יוסי פליג עליה דאבוה דמתניתין, וקאמר דאפילו לשיירא בעינן שתי וערב:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:12:1.english: Any partition that is not, etc. - Rabbi Yosei disagrees with his father in the mishna, and says that even for a caravan we require [both] warp and woof.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:12:2.english: One of the two things - Either warp or woof.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:13:1.hebrew: הרי אמרו עומד מרובה על הפרוץ בשתי הוי עומד - אע"ג דאיכא פרצות, כדתנן לעיל: "ולא יהו פרצות יתירות על הבנין". וסתם כלי בהמה של שתי הוא, שעומד על גבי קרקע:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:13:1.english: Behold, they said: [Where the] standing [portion is] greater than the breached [portion] in warp, it is [considered] standing - Even though there are breaches, as we learned above: “And there will not be breaches greater than the built [portion].” And ordinary animal equipment is [considered] warp, as it stands upon the ground.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:13:2.hebrew: בערב מאי - מחבלים דמתני' ליכא למילף הכשירה, דהתם כולו עומד הוא, דכלבוד דמי:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:13:2.english: In [the case of] woof, what [is the law]? - From the ropes of our Mishnah, one cannot derive its validity, for there, it is entirely [considered] standing, since it is considered like lavud.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:15:1.hebrew: לעביד - אויר האחד פחות משלשה וחבל משהו, וכן שני, דהוי להו ששה עומד; והאויר השלישי פחות מארבעה וחבל משהו, ותיתכשר פירצת הד' בעומד של ששה:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:15:1.english: Let one make - The first airspace less than three [handbreadths] and a rope of any size, and likewise the second, so that they have six [handbreadths of] standing [partition]; and the third airspace less than four [handbreadths] and a rope of any size, and the breach of four [handbreadths] will be validated by the standing [partition] of six [handbreadths].

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:16:1.hebrew: שהגדיים בוקעין בה - ואפילו למעלה ממנו עומד י' טפחים שלימין, הא קיימא לן: מחיצה תלויה אינה מתרת:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:16:1.english: Through which goats pass - And even if above it there is a standing [partition of] ten full handbreadths, behold, we maintain that a suspended partition does not permit [carrying].

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:17:1.english: At the top - In the third airspace, which is the uppermost [one].

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:17:2.english: The airspace comes - That which is from the rope to the sky.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:17:3.hebrew: ודהאי גיסא - שממנו ולאמצעי — דהוי נמי אויר, כיון דהוי יותר משלשה — ומבטיל ליה לחבל, ואין כאן אלא ו' תחתונים:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:17:3.english: And on that side - That which is from it to the middle [rope] — which is also airspace, since it is more than three [handbreadths] — and it nullifies the rope; and there are only the lower six [handbreadths] here.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:18:1.hebrew: ואי מוקי לה באמצעי - אין כאן עומד מרובה על הפרוץ, אלא אם כן תצרף שתי רוחות לבטלו:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:18:1.english: And if he positions it in the middle - There is no standing [portion] greater than the breached [portion] here, unless you combine the two sides to nullify it [the breach].

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:19:1.hebrew: אלא - כיון דלא משכחת לה, רב המנונא הכי קמיבעיא ליה:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:19:1.english: Rather - Since you cannot find [a viable case for] it, this is what Rav Hamnuna was asking:

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:19:2.english: And left four [handbreadths] in it - [The four were] intact above, and a minute amount below.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:19:3.hebrew: ואוקמיה - להך גיסא דמשהו פחות מג' סמוך לקרקע, דהשתא הוה ליה עומד מרובה על הפרוץ מרוח אחת. ואוירא דהאי גיסא ודהאי גיסא נמי ליכא למימר, הואיל ועומד מרובה על האויר דתותיה מיניה:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:19:3.english: And positioned it - [He positioned] that side with the tiny bit less than three [handbreadths] close to the ground, so that now the standing [portion] is greater than the breached [portion] from one direction. And neither can one say that the airspace on this side and on that side [negates it], since the standing [portion] is greater than the airspace beneath it.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:1:1.hebrew: אתאן לרשב"ג וכו' - כלומר: עד ד', ולא ד' בכלל — דהא תנא בבא אחריתי: כל שהוא ד', ומד' עד י' אמות. אתאן לרשב"ג, דקא מפליג נמי בין פחות מד' לד':
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:1:1.english: We have arrived at Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, etc. - That is to say: “Up to four” — and four is not included [in this clause], for it taught another clause: “Anything that is four [handbreadths], and from four up to ten cubits.” [Therefore,] we have arrived at Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, who also distinguishes between less than four and four.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:1:2.hebrew: ה"ג דאי רבנן מג' ועד ד' ג' וד' חד הוא - מג' ועד ד' — בתמיה: היכי מפליג ד' מג', דקתני עד ולא עד בכלל (דתני סיפא: כל שהוא ד' כו')? הא לרבנן, ג' וד' חד הוא:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:1:2.english: This is the correct reading: "For if [it were according to] the Rabbis: From three to four? Three and four are one [and the same]" - [The phrase] "From three to four" is [stated] in astonishment: How does [the baraita] distinguish four [handbreadths] from three, such that it teaches "up to," [meaning] up to but not including [four] (as the latter clause teaches: "Whatever is four [handbreadths], etc.")? Behold, according to the Rabbis, three and four are one [and the same].

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:20:1.hebrew: מחיצה תלויה מיבעיא ליה - מחצלת עשרה שהגביהה מן הקרקע שלשה או יותר, מיבעיא ליה לרב המנונא: אי מבטל העומד לפרוץ שמתחתיו — הואיל ופחות ממנו — או לא:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:20:1.english: A suspended partition was his dilemma - [Regarding] a mat of ten [handbreadths] that one raised three [handbreadths] or more from the ground, Rav Hamnuna raised a dilemma: Does the standing [segment] nullify the breached [segment] beneath it — since [the breached segment] is less than it — or not?

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:20:2.hebrew: אלא במים - להתיר למלאות, כגון גזוזטרא שהיא למעלה מן המים בפרק כיצד משתתפין (לקמן עירובין ד' פז:):
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:20:2.english: Only over water - To permit drawing [water], such as a balcony that is above the water in the chapter [entitled] 'Keitzad Mishtatfin' (below, Eruvin 87b):

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:21:1.english: All partitions of Shabbat - He is speaking of those flimsy partitions that are of warp or of woof, which they permitted for a multitude under pressing circumstances.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:21:2.hebrew: לא התירום ליחיד - אי הקיף בהן יותר מבית סאתים, ואף על גב שהוקף לדירה — שהרי לדור בהן בלילי שבת הקיפום מערב שבת. הא בית סאתים מיהא שרי:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:21:2.english: They did not permit them for an individual - If he enclosed with them [an area of] more than two beit se'ah, and even though it was enclosed for dwelling — for behold, they enclosed them on Shabbat eve to dwell in them on Shabbat night. Behold, [an area of] two beit se'ah at any rate is permitted.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:22:1.hebrew: ליתן להן כל צרכן - דהא דקאמר רבי יהודה בשיירא דברו ולא ליחיד — ליתן לו כל צרכו בהנך מחיצות קאמר, אבל בית סאתים ודאי יהבינן ליה, הואיל ולדירה הקיפה. ובהא שיירא עדיפא — דיהבינן להו כל צרכן:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:22:1.english: To give them all their needs - For that which Rabbi Yehuda said, "[The Sages] spoke of a caravan" and not of an individual — he meant [specifically with regard] to giving him all his needs with these partitions; but [an area of] two beit se’a we certainly give him, since he enclosed it for habitation. And in this [regard] a caravan is superior — that we give them all their needs.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:24:1.english: For ropes - [One is] permitted [to carry] with an enclosure of ropes, even though there is only woof [i.e., horizontal elements] here.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:24:2.hebrew: נותנים לו בית סאתים - במחיצה זו, אבל במחיצה מעלייתא — כמה דבעי:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:24:2.english: He is given [an area of] two beit se’a - [This applies only] with this partition; but with a proper partition, [he may enclose] as much as he needs.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:25:1.english: That there will not be an unoccupied space of two beit se’a - That they should not enclose [an area of] two beit se’a more than their needs.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:26:1.hebrew: ליתן להם כל צרכן - הא דקאמר רבי יוסי דמתני' דאינה מחיצה — אינה מחיצה לכל צרכן, אבל מחיצה היא לבית סאתים לאחד ולבית שש לשיירא:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:26:1.english: To provide them with all their needs - That which Rabbi Yosei of the mishna said, that it is not a partition — [means] it is not a partition for all their needs, but it is a partition for a beit se'atayim for one [individual] and for a beit shesh for a caravan.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:3:1.english: This applies above - Such as [in the case of] a crossbeam.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:8:1.english: One surrounds with three ropes - It refers to a caravan that encamped in a valley.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:8:2.hebrew: זה למעלה מזה - על גבי יתדות סביב. מן התחתון לקרקע פחות מג', והוי כולו עומד, דכלבוד דמי. וממנו לאמצעי פחות מג', הרי ששה עומד פחות ב' משהויין בשני האוירין. ומאמצעי לעליון פחות משלשה, הרי בשלשה אוירין תשעה עומד פחות שלשה משהויין:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:8:2.english: One above another - [Placed] on stakes all around. From the bottom [rope] to the ground is less than three [handbreadths], and it is all [considered] a solid [partition], for it is considered *lavud* [contiguous]. And from it to the middle [rope is] less than three [handbreadths]; behold, [there are] six [handbreadths of] solid [partition], less two minute amounts in the two open spaces. And from the middle [rope] to the top [rope is] less than three [handbreadths]; behold, in the three open spaces, [there are] nine [handbreadths of] solid [partition], less three minute amounts.

Rashi on Eruvin 16b:9:1.hebrew: שיעור עובי החבלים יותר על טפח - שלשה משהויין, כדי שיהו הכל עשרה טפחים:
Rashi on Eruvin 16b:9:1.english: The measure of the thickness of the ropes [must be] greater than a handbreadth - [By] three minimal amounts, so that all together will be ten handbreadths.

Tosafot on Eruvin 16b:18:1.hebrew: אי מוקי לה בי מיצעי הוה ליה עומד מרובה על הפרוץ מב' רוחות - ולא הוה ליה עומד, משום דאתי אוירא דהאי גיסא ודהאי גיסא ומבטל ליה לעילאי. וקשה להשר מקוצי, דאכתי נעביד: פחות מג' וחבל משהו, ופחות מג' וחצי וחבל משהו, ופחות מג' וחבל חצי טפח ומשהו — ולמה לי עוביו יתר על טפח? ושמא בענין זה אתי למיטעי:
Tosafot on Eruvin 16b:18:1.english: "If he positions it in the middle, then the standing [segment] is greater than the breached [segment] from two sides" - And it would not be [considered] standing, because the air from this side and from that side comes and negates the upper [portion]. And the Sar of Coucy raised a difficulty: For we could still make [a partition with a space of] less than three [handbreadths] and a rope of any size, and [a space of] less than three and a half [handbreadths] and a rope of any size, and [a space of] less than three [handbreadths] and a rope of half a handbreadth and any [additional] amount — and why do I need its [combined] thickness to be greater than a handbreadth? And perhaps in this manner, one might come to make an error.

Tosafot on Eruvin 16b:6:1.hebrew: והלכתא כרב פפא - אין לתמוה: דהכא קי"ל פרוץ כעומד מותר, ובפ"ב דחולין (ד' כט.) מסיק לכ"ע מחצה על מחצה אינו כרוב, ומייתי עלה ההיא דתנור, והכא לא מייתי לה — ושמא יש לחלק בין מחיצות לאיסור וטומאה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 16b:6:1.english: "And the halakha is in accordance with Rav Pappa" - One should not wonder [about this]: for here we maintain that [when the] breached [portion] equals the standing [portion, it is] permitted, while in the second chapter of Chullin (29a), [the Gemara] concludes that according to everyone, half-and-half is not [considered] like a majority, and it cites in connection with this that [case] of the oven, whereas here it does not cite it — for perhaps one can distinguish between partitions and [matters of] prohibition and ritual impurity.
